consequence.statement: External secret stores are removed; if you use them, you must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The alpha, unmaintained external secret stores feature is removed in Crossplane v2; users must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text does not name a concrete configuration key, field or flag that shows external secret stores are in use.
